stories.title: Follow live: Josh Allen scores to put Bills on the board vs. Lions
DC Belichick resigns as UNC investigation finds disregard for conduct
stories.summary: North Carolina DC Steve Belichick has resigned as the university's probe into the football program's culture and climate found "isolated" disregard for standards of conduct.

stories.title: Bills' top DT Oliver inactive after suffering hip injury in warmups
stories.summary: The Buffalo Bills' standout defensive tackle Ed Oliver was a surprise inactive for Thursday night's game against the Detroit Lions.

stories.title: McVay says Rams 'hopeful' Donald will play vs. Giants on MNF
stories.summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will practice in full Thursday and the team is "hopeful" he will play Monday night against the Giants, coach Sean McVay said.

stories.title: Sarkisian: Mishandled ESPN interview, knows Manning owns his mistake
stories.summary: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian says he should have better handled his postgame interview after the win over Ohio State and acknowledged the testy exchange led to the creation of fake videos and an apology from star quarterback Arch Manning.
